scenes.text: One checkout request. One point eight four seconds. Somewhere, this got slow.
Meet Lantern. See where the time goes.
Lantern follows one request through every service. The gateway, checkout, then payments. Payments is where it waits.
Open the trace, and the time lines up. Payments spends more than a second on one database query.
Lantern suggests an index. Add it, and checkout drops to about two hundred milliseconds.
Lantern. See where the time goes. Private beta, next spring.
